Her hair is slightly messy from sleep. (3) She transitions to a bright indoor space, sitting at a wooden vanity with a circular gold-rimmed mirror. She smiles at herself, touching her cheeks with her fingers, and then examines her skin closely. (4) A montage sequence shows her applying various skincare products. She uses a dropper to apply a clear serum to her cheek and rubs it in. Then, she applies a cream using a small red heart-shaped massage tool (Gua Sha) along her jawline. She sits on a cream-colored beanbag chair, writing in a notebook and looking thoughtful. (7) She moves to a kitchen or dining area, where she bites into a large croissant and drinks from a glass of iced coffee. (8) Finally, she is shown dancing and twirling happily in a spacious room with white walls and a large wooden door, before the video ends with a reflected shot of her in the mirror.
